_comment: VB-31 (docs/plans/verbs.md): hand-verified ground truth for internal/analysis/serviceref's (method, path template) join. Each row is a fact a human read off the fixture source and confirmed by hand, independent of the extractor. precision = (rows the extractor correctly reports as should_join:true) / (all rows the extractor reports as joined); recall = (rows the extractor correctly reports as should_join:true) / (all should_join:true rows here). docs/bench/serviceref.md explains the full measurement procedure. 'real_pair' rows are the one hand-verified non-fixture pair VB-31 asks for; empty until a real fleet repo pair is documented (ADR-011: no org-specific names/hosts — a real pair must be sourced from a public or org-agnostic example before it can be added here).

pairs.note: GET /items/%s (client) and GET /items/:id (route) normalize to the same template — the fixture's one true cross-repo service_ref edge.
No route anywhere in the fixture fleet registers DELETE /items/{}/hold — the join must not manufacture an edge for this call.
No client call anywhere in the fixture fleet targets POST /items — a route with no matching caller must not appear as a hop either.
